name: Довідник и права редакторов
changes: Receipt revision floors prevent stale snapshots from undoing confirmed saves/deletions. Per-category busy and access-generation guards reject duplicates/old-account completions.
Catalog pull-to-refresh includes catalog, marker and whole server snapshot; refresh requests coalesce. Equal snapshots avoid redundant model notifications and cache rewrites.
Same-query candidate refresh retains confirmed rows on failure; failed-page retry preserves cursor. Visible candidate count excludes filtered owners and starts unknown.
Editing is disabled while publishing or after rights loss. Account changes dismiss editing; new topic/group/section drafts confirm discard.
Profile navigation honors hidden tab bar in editor-access destination and restores it on return.
Symbol search uses explicit shared field because native searchable did not render.
Translation action wraps at AX. Directory owner self-feedback removed; account changes close old feedback presentations.
Existing hosted auth-test scheduling failure addressed with readiness handshake and eight-test isolated CI gate.

baseline.meaning: Blocked owner access was already correct; same-query candidate refresh lost rows.

localDataflow.skipReason: Live production audit requires explicit opt-in and is exercised separately.

uiAttempts.note: Nested block/region/discard and old deletion regressions passed. Publish driver tapped a toolbar action while dismissing keyboard; switched to Return and verified persisted text.

Publication/reopen/discard, all role entries, recent route and four new unit tests passed. Rights grant/revoke succeeded but tab-bar-hidden assertions failed in both languages; root navigation corrected.

Rights mutation and tab restoration, translation/source validation, nested region/section, alternate-theme public search passed. Symbol selector had no rendered search field; fixed. Single Swift Testing method selector did not select live test; corrected in final suite.
